properties.method: OpenHistoricalMap relation, polygonized; Darfur (1904 Intelligence Office sheet, digitised from georeferenced LoC scan) removed; NW and Dar Fertit edges from the same sheet
properties.note: Darfur edge, the 1899 Anglo-French line in the north-west and the Dar Fertit/Kafia Kingi edge follow the 1904 Anglo-Egyptian Sudan sheet (WO_GSGS_1904). On that sheet Darfur's north edge is at about 16.4°N, so the desert from 16.4°N to 20°N is inside Sudan. Elsewhere the OpenHistoricalMap line is used where it agrees with the sheet within about 0.1° or the sheet does not cover it. The north-west line is the Anglo-French Declaration of 21 March 1899 (GLEICHEN1905_V1 vol. I p.285). Darfur edges are approximate: Darfur lies between 10° and 16°N and 22° and 27°30'E (GLEICHEN1905_V1 p.184). VERIFY

properties.method: OpenHistoricalMap relation, polygonized; SE (Kenya) edge from the georeferenced 1928 LoC War Office sheet
properties.note: South-east (Kenya) edge follows the 1928 War Office sheet (WO_GSGS_1928): the Sudan–Uganda line runs to about 34.4°E 4.62°N, then along about 4.62°N to about 35.78°E, agreeing with the PCGN coordinates (ILEMI_PCGN_SSD2024). The area between this line and the older OpenHistoricalMap line is shown separately as the contested Ilemi Triangle. No source dates a change within 1916–34, so this period is not split. VERIFY The 1934 change (Sarra Triangle to Libya) is dated to the year by LOC_LBY1987_FOURTHSHORE; the exact day is CONTESTED.

South-east (Kenya) edge follows the 1928 War Office sheet (WO_GSGS_1928): the Sudan–Uganda line runs to about 34.4°E 4.62°N, then along about 4.62°N to about 35.78°E, agreeing with the PCGN coordinates (ILEMI_PCGN_SSD2024). The area between this line and the older OpenHistoricalMap line is shown separately as the contested Ilemi Triangle. VERIFY The 1934 change (Sarra Triangle to Libya) is dated to the year by LOC_LBY1987_FOURTHSHORE; the exact day is CONTESTED.

properties.basis_en: PCGN (2024, p.3): Ilemi is disputed; it lies between 4°37'41"N, 34°24'22"E and 4°37'52"N, 35°46'50"E; 'Sudan first agreed to Kenyan administration of part of the Ilemi Triangle in 1928, without affecting its perceived sovereignty of the area.'
properties.start_note_en: Start 1928 from ILEMI_PCGN_SSD2024 p.3 (Kenyan administration of part of Ilemi agreed). End 1956 = end of the condominium era, not a boundary event.
properties.method: South edge: 4.62N line from the georeferenced 1928 (LoC) and 1939 (AUC) War Office sheets; north edge: the OHM 1916–34/1934–56 relation line (CC0), which is NOT a cited Ilemi limit (Red/Maud lines not digitised). Shape is the area between the two.
properties.license: Public domain (War Office sheets) + CC0 1.0 (OpenHistoricalMap); PCGN cited only
properties.note: The north edge is the OpenHistoricalMap line, not a sourced line (neither the Red Line nor the Maud Line). The south edge at about 4.6°N is from the 1928 sheet; no source dates this line. The 1902 treaty stops at 6°N 35°E (GLEICHEN1905_V1 p.295), and in 1904 the Sudan administration took 5°N (p.337). VERIFY
